scope: Complete projected row sets over the fixed released record snapshot and each item's WG partition.
source_scope: Source censuses and original-document readers measure source coverage and stored-link confirmation separately.
historical_exposure: This evaluation definition is distinct from the historical solver-task exposure; original tasks and questions remain unchanged.
row_semantics: Distinct projected rows; exact section identity, directed revision reachability and numeric plenary order follow the family-specific queries.

pack_lookup.identity: Document TDoc ID; CR number is qualified by specification.
pack_lookup.answer_universe: All packs containing the anchor, joined to their plenary meeting.
pack_lookup.eligibility: Pack membership and document-list pack fields agree at admission.

queries.cr_side:
SELECT DISTINCT p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting
        FROM cr_in_pack m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE m.cr = :anchor
queries.container_side:
SELECT DISTINCT p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting
        FROM pack_member m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE m.cr = :anchor

pack_lookup_empty.identity: Exact TDoc and specification/CR identity in the snapshot.
pack_lookup_empty.answer_universe: The pack-lookup row set is empty for this identity.
pack_lookup_empty.eligibility: Whole-target source-verified dispositions use the five closed-without-pack codes; same-identity pack/list checks also pass.

queries.cr_side:
SELECT DISTINCT p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting
        FROM cr_in_pack m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE m.cr = :anchor
queries.container_side:
SELECT DISTINCT p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting
        FROM pack_member m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE m.cr = :anchor

disposition_pack.answer_universe: Every eligible disposition/working-group meeting crossed with every recorded pack/plenary meeting.
disposition_pack.eligibility: Disposition evidence_status=source_verified and scope=whole_target; its resolution has a meeting.

queries.cr_side:
SELECT DISTINCT d.code, g.label, p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting
        FROM disposition d
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id
        JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = d.target JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE d.target = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
queries.container_side:
SELECT DISTINCT d.code, g.label, p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting
        FROM disposition d
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id
        JOIN pack_member m ON m.cr = d.target JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE d.target = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

full_chain.identity: Anchor TDoc ID; stored section IDs project to clause labels.
full_chain.answer_universe: Disposition-pack rows crossed with the anchor's stored section-change links having a parsed clause label.
full_chain.eligibility: Same disposition eligibility as disposition_pack. This family uses all stored section links, including edition-projected links; it applies no target-release filter.

queries.cr_side:
SELECT DISTINCT d.code, g.label, p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting, s.clause
        FROM disposition d
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id
        JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = d.target JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        JOIN cr_modifies_section c ON c.cr = d.target JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id
        WHERE d.target = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target' AND s.clause IS NOT NULL
queries.container_side:
SELECT DISTINCT d.code, g.label, p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting, s.clause
        FROM disposition d
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id
        JOIN pack_member m ON m.cr = d.target JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        JOIN section_modified_by c ON c.cr = d.target JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id
        WHERE d.target = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target' AND s.clause IS NOT NULL

revision_chain.identity: Directed revision reachability from the anchor, with duplicate reachable IDs removed.
revision_chain.answer_universe: Every later reachable document with an eligible disposition and pack, including qualifying intermediate versions.
revision_chain.eligibility: Anchor has revised dispositions at construction; returned versions have source_verified, whole_target dispositions whose resolution exists.

queries.cr_side:
WITH RECURSIVE later(id) AS (
            SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = :anchor
            UNION SELECT v.later FROM revision v JOIN later l ON v.earlier = l.id)
        SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, p.pack_number
        FROM later
        JOIN document doc ON doc.id = later.id
        JOIN disposition d ON d.target = later.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id
        JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = later.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
queries.container_side:
WITH RECURSIVE later(id) AS (
            SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = :anchor
            UNION SELECT v.later FROM revision v JOIN later l ON v.earlier = l.id)
        SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, p.pack_number
        FROM later
        JOIN document doc ON doc.id = later.id
        JOIN disposition d ON d.target = later.id JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id
        JOIN pack_member m ON m.cr = later.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

clause_history.identity: Exact section ID: specification, release and clause; children are separate IDs.
clause_history.answer_universe: All documents changing that exact section in their own target release, with eligible dispositions/meetings/packs.
clause_history.eligibility: document.target_release=section.release, source_verified and whole_target; admission checks relevant pack sources.

queries.cr_side:
SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, g.label, p.pack_number
        FROM cr_modifies_section c
        JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = c.cr
        JOIN disposition d ON d.target = c.cr
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id
        JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = c.cr JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE c.section_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
queries.container_side:
SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, g.label, p.pack_number
        FROM section_modified_by c
        JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = c.cr
        JOIN disposition d ON d.target = c.cr
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id
        JOIN pack_member m ON m.cr = c.cr JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE c.section_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

pack_origin.identity: Anchor pack ID and its recorded member document IDs.
pack_origin.answer_universe: All recorded member documents having eligible dispositions and working-group meetings.
pack_origin.eligibility: source_verified and whole_target; returned membership comes from pack-side records in the first reference direction.

queries.cr_side:
SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, g.label
        FROM pack_member m
        JOIN document doc ON doc.id = m.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = m.cr
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id
        WHERE m.pack_id = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
queries.container_side:
SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, d.code, g.label
        FROM cr_in_pack m
        JOIN document doc ON doc.id = m.cr JOIN disposition d ON d.target = m.cr
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id
        WHERE m.pack_id = :anchor AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

clause_neighbours.identity: Anchor document's exact section IDs in its target release; other document ID differs from anchor.
clause_neighbours.answer_universe: Every same-release other document changing a shared exact section, with eligible disposition/meeting/pack.
clause_neighbours.eligibility: Both documents' target releases equal the section release; other document has source_verified, whole_target disposition.

queries.cr_side:
SELECT DISTINCT s.clause, o.number, d.code, g.label, p.pack_number
        FROM cr_modifies_section cx
        JOIN document x ON x.id = cx.cr JOIN section s ON s.id = cx.section_id
        JOIN cr_modifies_section co ON co.section_id = s.id JOIN document o ON o.id = co.cr
        JOIN disposition d ON d.target = o.id
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id
        JOIN cr_in_pack m ON m.cr = o.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE cx.cr = :anchor AND o.id <> :anchor AND x.target_release = s.release
            AND o.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
queries.container_side:
SELECT DISTINCT s.clause, o.number, d.code, g.label, p.pack_number
        FROM section_modified_by cx
        JOIN document x ON x.id = cx.cr JOIN section s ON s.id = cx.section_id
        JOIN section_modified_by co ON co.section_id = s.id JOIN document o ON o.id = co.cr
        JOIN disposition d ON d.target = o.id
        JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id JOIN meeting g ON g.id = r.meeting_id
        JOIN pack_member m ON m.cr = o.id JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id
        WHERE cx.cr = :anchor AND o.id <> :anchor AND x.target_release = s.release
            AND o.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'

first_change.identity: Anchor pack; exact section ID and CR target release.
first_change.answer_universe: Each eligible anchor-pack member/section with no same-release changer in any pack at a smaller plenary meeting number.
first_change.eligibility: Current member has source_verified, whole_target disposition; earlier changers use recorded membership regardless of disposition eligibility.

queries.cr_side:
SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, s.spec, s.clause
        FROM cr_in_pack m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = m.cr
        JOIN disposition d ON d.target = m.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id
        JOIN cr_modifies_section c ON c.cr = m.cr JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id
        WHERE m.pack_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM cr_modifies_section c2 JOIN document d2 ON d2.id = c2.cr
                JOIN cr_in_pack m2 ON m2.cr = c2.cr JOIN cr_pack p2 ON p2.id = m2.pack_id
                WHERE c2.section_id = s.id AND d2.target_release = s.release
                    AND p2.tsg_number < p.tsg_number)
queries.container_side:
SELECT DISTINCT doc.number, s.spec, s.clause
        FROM pack_member m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = m.cr
        JOIN disposition d ON d.target = m.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id
        JOIN section_modified_by c ON c.cr = m.cr JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id
        WHERE m.pack_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM section_modified_by c2 JOIN document d2 ON d2.id = c2.cr
                JOIN pack_member m2 ON m2.cr = c2.cr JOIN cr_pack p2 ON p2.id = m2.pack_id
                WHERE c2.section_id = s.id AND d2.target_release = s.release
                    AND p2.tsg_number < p.tsg_number)

previous_pack.identity: Anchor pack; exact section ID and CR target release.
previous_pack.answer_universe: All packs tied at the largest plenary meeting number strictly below the anchor meeting for each touched section.
previous_pack.eligibility: Current member has source_verified, whole_target disposition; earlier changers use recorded membership regardless of disposition eligibility. Sections with no earlier pack contribute no row.

queries.cr_side:
WITH touched AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT s.id AS sid, s.spec, s.clause, s.release, p.tsg_number AS t
            FROM cr_in_pack m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = m.cr
            JOIN disposition d ON d.target = m.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id
            JOIN cr_modifies_section c ON c.cr = m.cr JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id
            WHERE m.pack_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'),
        prev AS (
            SELECT t.sid, t.spec, t.clause, p2.pack_number, p2.tsg_meeting, p2.tsg_number
            FROM touched t JOIN cr_modifies_section c2 ON c2.section_id = t.sid JOIN document d2 ON d2.id = c2.cr
            JOIN cr_in_pack m2 ON m2.cr = c2.cr JOIN cr_pack p2 ON p2.id = m2.pack_id
            WHERE d2.target_release = t.release AND p2.tsg_number < t.t)
        SELECT DISTINCT spec, clause, pack_number, tsg_meeting FROM prev
        WHERE tsg_number = (SELECT max(q.tsg_number) FROM prev q WHERE q.sid = prev.sid)
queries.container_side:
WITH touched AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT s.id AS sid, s.spec, s.clause, s.release, p.tsg_number AS t
            FROM pack_member m JOIN cr_pack p ON p.id = m.pack_id JOIN document doc ON doc.id = m.cr
            JOIN disposition d ON d.target = m.cr JOIN resolution r ON r.id = d.resolution_id
            JOIN section_modified_by c ON c.cr = m.cr JOIN section s ON s.id = c.section_id
            WHERE m.pack_id = :anchor AND doc.target_release = s.release AND d.evidence_status = 'source_verified' AND d.scope = 'whole_target'),
        prev AS (
            SELECT t.sid, t.spec, t.clause, p2.pack_number, p2.tsg_meeting, p2.tsg_number
            FROM touched t JOIN section_modified_by c2 ON c2.section_id = t.sid JOIN document d2 ON d2.id = c2.cr
            JOIN pack_member m2 ON m2.cr = c2.cr JOIN cr_pack p2 ON p2.id = m2.pack_id
            WHERE d2.target_release = t.release AND p2.tsg_number < t.t)
        SELECT DISTINCT spec, clause, pack_number, tsg_meeting FROM prev
        WHERE tsg_number = (SELECT max(q.tsg_number) FROM prev q WHERE q.sid = prev.sid)
